title: 第二十三章 龙诞日上第二十四章 龙诞日中
lines: 暮色还未降临，集会地却已热闹非凡。
雏龙们从山谷各处汇聚而来，把砂石地挤得密密实实，许多甚至提前就在这里等待了，小龙们摇头晃脑，脸上无一不挂着期待和好奇的神情。
今天是龙诞日。
所谓龙诞日，就是雏龙们集体出生的日子，当初家族把它们从各处搜集过来，用魔法控制在同一天孵化，这样既方便家族哺育教养，也利于小龙们接受族群观念、相互结交竞争。
因此，三月十二这一天，就成了它们共同的生日。
破壳之后第一年，是雏龙生长发育最快最迅速的时期，一年的时间过去，昔日那些头大肚圆、四肢短小的幼崽，如今尽数换了另外一幅模样。
这些家伙刚破壳时只有家猫那么大，可现在即使是最小的钨龙、镍龙，也陆续长到一米半左右。
而铁龙、钴龙那样的大型种，个个都超过两米，说是雏龙，却比成年的雄狮还更大些。
它们的鳞片完全硬化，闪烁出各异的金属光泽，此时此刻，雏龙们三三两两盘踞在砂石地里，区分出各自的分界，躁动的气息相互挤压，活动间鳞片碰撞，仿佛金属低鸣。
但凡有谁不耐烦的拍打地面、或是动作稍微大些，立刻引来一阵充满示威性质的低吼。
集会地罕见的点了火，篝火烧得正旺，噼里啪啦，把暮色烤得发暖，狗头人绕着窝棚忙碌，举着各式各样的器具来回奔走，数量比平时数倍还多。
“因塔斯怎么不过来？”
莫奇迈着轻快的步伐走近，来到西隆身边，蜷身趴下，刚想闲聊几句，就被空气中的气味吸引，“哎呀，什么东西搞这么香？”
“我让他回去了，次龙都待在那边，显得合群。”
西隆嘴上回应，眼睛却也盯着那座火台，看狗头人在窝棚里忙碌。
食物的气味和平日里雏龙吃惯的血食截然不同，温和、醇厚，不含一点腥气，反而带着被火与烟反复侵染过的香味，随着晚风漫过山谷。
惹得满场小龙喉咙滚动，不安分的踩踏四爪。
片刻后，上方传来沉重的脚步声。
躁动的集会地迅速安静下来，最前排的铁龙率先低头，接着是铬龙、钴龙，再往后，钨龙镍龙和外围的次龙也陆续收敛声息，伏低身躯。
砂石地所有雏龙，齐刷刷转向同一个方向，对着同一道身躯垂首致意。
迦卓萨·燃心的身躯足有十五米，鳞片深黑，泛着森然的铁光，巍峨、沉重，像一座移动的山，令雏龙们油然而生一种本能的敬畏。
“在这样的青年龙面前，雏龙恐怕很难拥有叛逆期了。”
虽然低着头，西隆的脑袋却还是很活络。
青年龙在高台上盘踞下来，平静的环顾所有雏龙，一只一只，不疾不缓。
被她目光注视到的小龙，都不由自主将身体伏低，尽可能想要表现成熟，又控制不住畏惧和亲昵，显得十分局促。
“恭喜你们度过生命中最孱弱的一年，没有雏龙夭折，也没有雏龙残缺，你们每一个都很好，健康、茁壮，符合家族对你们的期待。”
迦卓萨缓缓开口，“今天是为你们庆祝的时刻，我没有长篇大论要说，只是你们都长大了，作为喂哺者，有责任向你们介绍今天的食物。”
青年龙轻点爪趾，外围窸窸窣窣的脚步声立刻响起。
狗头人们从火台两侧鱼贯而入，合力捧着一只只巨大的石盘，小心翼翼穿过龙群，把那些石盘一一摆放在雏龙面前。
肉香浓郁，雏龙们不由绷起身子，眼神都挪不开，但喂哺者积威深重，青年龙不开口，没有任何小龙敢于先动。
“这是豺狼人猎到的暴怒熊兽，由灰矮人转运而来，地精缴纳海盐，飞猿贡献卤酱，侍鳞人送来香料，狗头人负责烹饪，才做成这道菜。”
迦卓萨缓缓说：“我们烬痕家族，控制着失落荒野所有的山川河流，领地南至赤潮滩，北抵钢脊平原，途经溪流地、赭石谷、灰山黑湖和红堡。”
“几十个部族向我们的战旗效忠，家族七位巨龙领主统治的智慧种族，人口总计超过五十万。”
“这是眷属们向家族新一代，献上的礼物。”
集会地发出一阵明显的骚动，雏龙们窃窃私语。
莫奇发出低低的惊叹声，在他的脑海里，家族只是一个很大、很强的概念，直到喂哺者这样描述，才终于能够想象出一个完整的图景。
“之前大概猜到了。”
content_en:
Dusk has not yet fallen, but the gathering place is already bustling with activity.
The baby dragons gathered from all over the valley, crowding the gravel ground tightly. Many of them even waited here in advance. The baby dragons shook their heads, all with expressions of anticipation and curiosity on their faces.
Today is Dragon's Birthday.
The so-called Dragon Birthday is the day when the baby dragons are born collectively. The family originally collected them from all over the place and used magic to control them to hatch on the same day. This not only facilitates the family's raising and education, but also helps the baby dragons accept the concept of the group and make friends and compete with each other.
Therefore, March 12th has become their common birthday.
The first year after breaking out of the shell is the fastest and most rapid period for the dragon's growth and development. One year has passed, and the cubs that used to have big heads, round bellies, and short limbs have now changed to a completely different appearance.
When these guys first hatched, they were only as big as a house cat, but now even the smallest tungsten dragons and nickel dragons have gradually grown to about one and a half meters.
Large species such as the Iron Dragon and the Cobalt Dragon are each over two meters tall. Although they are young dragons, they are larger than adult lions.
Their scales are completely hardened, shining with different metallic lusters. At this moment, the young dragons are entrenched in twos and threes in the gravel ground, distinguishing their respective boundaries. Their restless breaths are squeezing each other, and their scales collide during movement, as if they are metal.
Whenever someone slaps the ground impatiently or makes a slightly louder movement, there will immediately be a low demonstration-like roar.
A rare fire was lit at the gathering place. The bonfire was burning brightly and crackling, making the dusk warm. The kobolds were busy around the shack, running back and forth holding various utensils. The number was several times more than usual.
"Why doesn't Intas come over?"
Mochi approached with brisk steps, came to Shillong's side, curled up and lay down. He was just about to chat for a few words when he was attracted by the smell in the air, "Oh, what makes something so fragrant?"
"I asked him to go back, and Cilong stayed there, looking sociable."
Shillong responded, but his eyes were fixed on the fire platform, watching the kobolds busy in the shack.
The smell of the food was completely different from the blood food that the young dragons were used to eating. It was mild, mellow, and did not contain any fishy smell. Instead, it carried a scent that had been repeatedly contaminated by fire and smoke, and spread through the valley with the evening breeze.
This caused the little dragons in the audience to roll their throats and stamp on their four paws restlessly.
After a while, heavy footsteps were heard from above.
The restless gathering quickly quieted down. The iron dragon in the front row bowed his head first, followed by the chrome dragon and cobalt dragon. After that, the tungsten dragon, nickel dragon and the secondary dragons on the periphery also gradually calmed down and lowered their bodies.
All the young dragons on the gravel ground turned in the same direction and bowed their heads to the same body.
The body of Gadrosa Burning Heart is fifteen meters long. Its scales are dark black and glow with a strong iron light. It is towering and heavy, like a moving mountain, which makes the young dragons feel an instinctive awe.
"In front of such a young dragon, it may be difficult for the young dragon to have a rebellious stage."
Although his head was lowered, Shillong's head was still very active.
The young dragon sat down on the high platform and calmly looked around at all the young dragons, one by one, without any hurry or delay.
The little dragon caught her gaze couldn't help but lower his body, trying to appear mature as much as possible, but unable to control his fear and intimacy, he looked very embarrassed.
"Congratulations on how you have passed the weakest year of your life. No baby dragon has died, and no baby dragon has been mutilated. Each of you is fine, healthy and strong, and meets the family's expectations for you."
Gadrosa spoke slowly, "Today is a time to celebrate for you. I don't have a long speech to say, but you have all grown up. As a feeder, I have the responsibility to introduce today's food to you."
The young dragon tapped his claws, and the sound of rustling footsteps immediately sounded outside.
The kobolds filed in from both sides of the fire platform, holding huge stone plates together, carefully passing through the group of dragons, and placing the stone plates one by one in front of the young dragon.
The meat was so fragrant that the baby dragons couldn't help but tense up and couldn't move their eyes away. However, the feeder had such a powerful power that the young dragon didn't open his mouth and no one dared to move first.
"This is a furious bear beast hunted by gnolls. It was transported by gray dwarves. The goblins paid for the sea salt, the flying apes contributed the marinade, the scale waiters sent the spices, and the kobolds were responsible for cooking, so this dish was made."
Gadrosa said slowly: "We, the Ashhen Family, control all the mountains and rivers in the Lost Wilderness. Our territory extends from the Crimson Tide Flats in the south to the Steel Ridge Plains in the north, passing through the Stream Land, Ocher Valley, Gray Mountain Black Lake and the Red Keep."
"Dozens of tribes are loyal to our battle flag. The intelligent race ruled by seven dragon lords in the family has a total population of more than half a million."
"This is a gift presented by the family members to the new generation of the family."
There was a palpable commotion in the gathering place, and the hatchlings murmured.
"Ah..."
Mochi let out a low exclamation. In his mind, family was just a big, strong concept. It wasn't until the feeder described it like this that he was finally able to imagine a complete picture.
"I probably guessed it before."
